rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility onboarding (breast-ct-claude-agentic-wu-2015-search-20260703-01, strict 20-min budget, re-split breast val=200). This is the CLASSICAL NON-TRAINABLE Wu-2015 FBP baseline (0 params, no learning) -- distinct from wu_2015_trainable. Seeded from the trainable-sibling family optimum (search-20260703-01 iter-1 hr=0.3009 at n_bands=6,n_outer=2,motion_range=8,motion_window=2,soft_thresh=0.0015) since the classical solver shares the same 5 structural knobs; a prior breast TPE reached hr~0.31 for this family. val_n=200 = ALL re-split breast val cases (do NOT exceed 200), seed=42. HYPOTHESIS: the family-optimum structural config produces a finite val_ssim that CLEARS the 128-view breast FBP baseline (hr>0) in ~1-2 min, establishing the classical onboarding baseline that iters 2-20 refine one knob at a time.
